title: Fennec Shand
description: Fett saved Fennec Shand's life by taking her to The Modifier. The pair tracked down Mandalorian Din Djarin to recover Fett's armor, then helped Djarin rescue Grogu. Then they overthrew Bib Fortuna. During the Battle of Mos Espa, Shand assassinated the leadership of the Pyke Syndicate and the other crime families to establish Fett's dominance.
